requirements.rule: FIRST-LEVEL PERIOD (All. F, p. 86): 'la retribuzione, in ragione del titolo da conseguire e dell'anno scolastico/formativo di effettiva frequenza, è stabilita in percentuale'; the table of pp. 86-87 maps the school years of each course to the 45/55/60/70% rows. The data keys the rows by year of the contract, which differs for an apprentice hired after the first school year of the course.
requirements.remediation: Key the first-level rows by the course and the school year attended (Apprentice.school_year).

requirements.rule: BILATERAL FUNDS. EBAN (Ente Bilaterale Agricolo Nazionale) and Agrifondo (supplementary pension) bilateral contributions are not modelled.
requirements.remediation: Pass the EBAN and Agrifondo contributions as bilateral fund events, or model them.

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour follows the national CCNL rule on the hours of a day of leave (art. 32 c. 1-bis D.Lgs. 151/2001, work_rules.parental_hourly), or without one the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter: half the average daily hours a day, two such days a day of leave, no cumulation with the nursing rests on the same day (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.1-2.2). The run records this limitation while the bundle does not record the rule of the CCNL; a company or territorial agreement is the fact local_hourly_agreement of the event.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.
